question: The causative agent of syphilis:

options.opa: It belongs to the genus Spirochaeta.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: It belongs to the genus Spirochaeta -> It has periplasmic flagella (endoflagella) -> It is the causative agent of syphilis -> 80% CHAIN: It has a polar flagellum -> It is not the causative agent of syphilis -> 70% CHAIN: It is strict aerobics -> It is not the causative agent of syphilis -> 80%
analysis: The causative agent of syphilis belongs to the genus Spirochaeta and has periplasmic flagella (endoflagella). It is not strict aerobics and does not have a polar flagellum.
